en: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David.

zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用第八。

p.src: 1  Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

en: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
u.src: 1  Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

p.src: 2  Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

en: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
u.src: 2  Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

p.src: 3  May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

en: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
u.src: 3  May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

p.src: 4  who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

en: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
u.src: 4  who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

p.src: 5  “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

en: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
u.src: 5  “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

p.src: 6  The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

en: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
u.src: 6  The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

p.src: 7  You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

en: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
u.src: 7  You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

p.src: 8  The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

en: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
u.src: 8  The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
